title: MemoryProfileUpdateRequest
description: Create or update one profile document. expected_revision null means create-only. Reflection invalidation commits in the same transaction (MEM-R013). Grant: profile_write. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

profile_kind.description: Authored content kind. Core (documented, not enforced): personality, preferences (§4.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
